# Pinned Python deps for the hosted CI board-free gate (.github/workflows/ci.yml,
# `make check-ci`). These mirror the deployment box (python 3.8).
#
# pyverify and socket_harness are imported via PYTHONPATH, NOT pip-installed, so
# their `requires-python = ">=3.10"` metadata never blocks the 3.8 box that
# actually runs the gate -- only their test-time deps are listed here.
#
#   pytest   -- the test runner for stages 3-4.
#   pydantic -- host/pyverify/tests/test_tender_plugin.py needs it (the test
#               importorskips when absent, but installing it exercises the
#               tender-plugin path rather than skipping it).
#   cocotb   -- IMPORT-ONLY, NO simulator. tests/common/regmap.py imports cocotb
#               at top level, so two pure-logic tests (test_regmap,
#               test_swap_sequence) fail COLLECTION without it. Pinned to the
#               box's 1.7.2. The @cocotb.test() benches themselves are excluded
#               by tests/conftest.py and run only on the self-hosted full gate
#               (make check SIM=vcs), which has a real simulator.
#   pyyaml   -- tests/identify_iice (manifest.py, provenance.py) reads YAML
#               manifests with PyYAML when importable and a strict-subset
#               fallback parser otherwise; the fallback does NOT parse the
#               test fixtures (run 34474922254: 7 failures + 42 errors on the
#               hosted runner, green on the box, which has PyYAML 6.0.1).
pytest>=7,<9
pyyaml>=6,<7
pydantic>=2,<3
cocotb==1.7.2
